intervals.note: Start is the date of the Nab design paper (1 October 2008), a lower bound for the proposal; the approval and construction-start dates are not stated in a source consulted.
intervals.quote: The Nab collaboration will perform a precise measurement of 'a', the electron-neutrino correlation parameter, and 'b', the Fierz interference term in neutron beta decay, in the Fundamental Neutron Physics Beamline at the SNS

intervals.label: commissioning and data-collection campaigns
intervals.note: Start is the date of the paper saying the spectrometer "is being commissioned". A commissioning dataset was taken in 2023 and data-collection campaigns followed in 2024 and 2025; as of November 2025 the detector upgrades were "setting the stage for high precision physics data-taking" (arXiv:2511.16678).
intervals.quote: The Nab spectrometer is being commissioned at the Fundamental Neutron Physics Beamline at the Spallation Neutron Source at Oak Ridge National Lab.

placements.note: SNS complex campus-grade site; the Fundamental Neutron Physics Beamline hall is not located in a fetched source.
placements.quote: The Nab spectrometer is being commissioned at the Fundamental Neutron Physics Beamline at the Spallation Neutron Source at Oak Ridge National Lab.

summary.plain: A long magnetic spectrometer in which the electron and proton from each neutron decay are guided to two large silicon detectors, one measuring the electron energy and the other the proton arrival time.
summary.technical: Asymmetric spectrometer with a main electrode system; hexagonally segmented silicon detectors for electron energy and proton time-of-flight (momentum); gaseous-helium detector cooling.

technology.quote: Nab utilizes a novel, long asymmetric spectrometer that guides the decay electron and proton to two large area silicon detectors
technology.value: Long asymmetric spectrometer guiding the decay electron and proton to two large-area silicon detectors
